headline: Executive order sets up a presidential commission to study and recommend ways to strengthen Social Security.
what_it_does: This order creates a President's Commission To Strengthen Social Security. Based on the title, the commission's job is to study the Social Security program and give the President advice on how to strengthen it. A commission like this makes recommendations. It does not change benefits or taxes by itself.

who_it_affects.group: People who get or will get Social Security benefits
who_it_affects.how: The commission's advice could shape future proposals about the program, but the order itself does not change their benefits.
They are named to serve on the commission and carry out its study and advice work.
